keyPoses.prompt:
Professional hand-drawn game animation sprite sheet: 16 sequential frames of this exact undead armoured brown-bear knight WALKING RIGHT, arranged 4 columns x4 rows on a square transparent canvas.
Use a STRICT RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE in every frame, like a classic side-scrolling game. Camera looks at his right side at90degrees to his travel, NOT the three-quarter front view of the reference. Both hips project to the SAME horizontal location, making the alternating leg motion clearly readable. Preserve the bear identity, decayed face, round ears, massive rusty iron armour, skull belt, ragged crimson cloak/tabard, and rusty sword held low in the same paw. Keep thick natural bear legs with anatomically connected hips/knees/shins/flat clawed hindpaws, original height and proportions. Entire complete figure and blade isolated within each cell with generous transparent margins.
A real normal walking gait: near leg and far leg alternate taking weight, bending at knees and swinging forward, heels roll and toes push off, small natural shoulder counter-motion, minimal vertical bob, no limping or jumping. The walk is drawn IN PLACE at a constant scale and body pivot, common foot baseline. Low foot lift, knees bend naturally, maintain thick leg volume.
Frame1 near foot forward / far foot back CONTACT.
Frame5 far leg PASSING UNDER body, near foot supports.
Frame9 far foot forward / near foot back OPPOSITE CONTACT. This is visibly opposite to frame1, NOT a duplicate.
Frame13 near leg PASSING UNDER body, far foot supports.
The other twelve frames are evenly spaced in-betweens connecting these poses into ONE seamless complete two-step walk cycle, last frame flows into first. Near leg remains visibly distinct in foreground during its swing from back to front; do not reset the same leg to leading every8frames. Body/head stay consistent and face right in ALL16frames, never rotate to camera.
This is a single coherent whole-character drawing in each cell, NOT cut-out limb pieces, rubber limbs or puppet segments. Crisp detailed painted pixel-art matching the reference. True alpha-zero transparency. No shadows, floor, haze, text, labels, grid, motion lines, cut-off head, cut-off sword or cut-off feet.

inbetweens.prompt:
